newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria depo rates flat amid low demand for funds. [CORRECTED 14:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria depo rates flat amid low demand for funds. [CORRECTED 14:10 GMT]

text.p: Demand for interbank deposits was very low on Wednesday despite settlement payments for Monday's T-bill auctions and lev funds rates were unchanged from Tuesday, dealers said.
"Trade is very dull due to low demand. Banks have enough free liquidity," said a bank dealer.
Banks had to pay on Wednesday the three- and 12-month discount T-bills with a total par of 45 billion levs they bought on Monday.
Overnight depo rates stood at 1.75-2.0 percent annually, flat from Tuesday. Spot week rates were around 3.5-4.0 percent annual, also unchanged.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 2.15 percent on Tuesday against 2.24 percent on Monday, a central bank official said.
The central bank's simple annual main interest rate has been set at 6.12 percent since Monday. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
